answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 1833 Country: India Title: Is bank loan permisible in India for business purpose? if yes what are the criteria and if no why? Question: Is bank loan permisible in India for business purpose? if yes what are the criteria and if no why? Answer ID: 1833 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 683/679=N) It is not allowed; because this involves giving interest, and both giving and taking interest is haram : قال تعالی: و احل اللہ البیع و حرم الربوا (الآیۃ) و لعن رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: اٰکل الربوا و مؤکلہ و کاتبہ و شاھدیہ و قال ھم سواء (مسلم و ترمذی) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
